json.title: Pink Peaks of Gangtok
json.logline: A young man wakes on a winter trip to Gangtok to watch the Himalayan peaks turn radiant pink in the morning sun.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: Felt piano enters as blue-violet shadow covers the sleepy mountain hotel terrace.
Golden amber highlights strike the wooden railing in painterly brushwork.
Four-on-the-floor kick kicks in as warm sunlight reaches the boy on the balcony.
Massive bloom of vivid pink and gold across snow-capped Himalayan summits.
Collage of gouache snow reflections and mountain contours floating across the sky.
Kick drum drops out, leaving a single soft rosy peak in gentle haze.
Final warm chord decays into quiet rose-tinted dawn glow.

scenes.camera_note: Slow push toward the subject looking out from a chilly hotel terrace.
scenes.action: The young man looks out across the frosty wooden railing into the dim morning air.
scenes.setting: A quiet wooden hotel balcony overlooking deep blue mountain shadows in Gangtok.

scenes.camera_note: Lateral drift widening the panorama of painted snow peaks.
scenes.action: The young man stands quietly against a panoramic backdrop of distant misty ridges.
scenes.setting: Sweeping Himalayan landscape under an amber sunrise sky with soft sage foliage.

scenes.camera_note: Tilting up smoothly from the icy railing to the young man's profile.
scenes.action: The young man tilts his head slightly toward the brightening horizon.
scenes.setting: Balcony corner catching glowing early morning halation.

scenes.camera_note: Quick push in on the steamy brass cup as morning light catches it.
scenes.action: Steam rises gently from a warm brass cup sitting on the frost-covered wooden ledge.
scenes.setting: Detailed view of an icy windowsill with soft rose reflections.

scenes.camera_note: Wide pull out to capture the breathtaking pink mountain reveal.
scenes.action: The young man raises a hand to shield his eyes from the glowing pink mountain peak.
scenes.setting: Dramatic Gangtok mountain vantage point as the snow peaks ignite in vibrant rose pink.

scenes.camera_note: Layered paper-like movement across gouache textures and mountain slopes.
scenes.action: The young man walks along the mountain ridge path under brilliant sunrise light.
scenes.setting: Layered mountain road in Gangtok bordered by snow-dusted pine trees.

scenes.camera_note: Gentle dolly out as the morning light softens into peaceful dawn.
scenes.action: The young man smiles softly with rose sunlight catching the frames of his eyeglasses.
scenes.setting: Softly lit hotel terrace bathed in gentle pastel morning tones.
